mapping_objects.capability_description: Separate Enterprise Workspaces on Mobile End-User Devices
mapping_objects.comments: A managed work profile can prevent notification listener applications in the personal profile from reading notifications generated by enterprise applications.

mapping_objects.capability_description: Separate Enterprise Workspaces on Mobile End-User Devices
mapping_objects.comments: Separate enterprise workspaces isolate managed application storage and configuration from applications running in the personal profile, reducing cross-profile collection of enterprise application data.

mapping_objects.capability_description: Separate Enterprise Workspaces on Mobile End-User Devices
mapping_objects.comments: Managed work profiles and managed pasteboard controls can restrict copying enterprise clipboard contents into unmanaged applications.

mapping_objects.capability_description: Separate Enterprise Workspaces on Mobile End-User Devices
mapping_objects.comments: Work profiles can maintain enterprise calendars separately and restrict which personal profile applications can access cross profile calendar information.

mapping_objects.capability_description: Separate Enterprise Workspaces on Mobile End-User Devices
mapping_objects.comments: Enterprise contact data can be isolated in the managed profile, with cross profile contact access limited to approved applications.

mapping_objects.capability_description: Separate Enterprise Workspaces on Mobile End-User Devices
mapping_objects.comments: Enterprise accounts provisioned inside a managed workspace are separated from personal profile applications, reducing unauthorized account enumeration across the profile boundary.
